questions.stem: Lateral and medial antebrachial cutaneous nerve block: which surgery is it indicated for?
options: Superficial forearm surgery, such as arteriovenous fistula creation

questions.stem: When is the lateral and medial antebrachial cutaneous block used alongside a brachial plexus block?
questions.answer: To supplement an incomplete brachial plexus block

questions.stem: For the LAC block, how many injections are made along the intercondylar line?
In the LAC block, what volume goes just deep to the lateral edge of the biceps tendon?
For the LAC block, where is the second 5 mL injection given?
questions.answer: Subcutaneously, lateral to the first, along the elbow crease

questions.stem: What local anaesthetic volume is used for the medial antebrachial cutaneous nerve block?
How is the medial antebrachial cutaneous nerve blocked?
questions.answer: Subcutaneous half-ring about a quarter of the arm's length above the medial elbow
